references.text: Moses repeats the list of the seven nations that the Lord will drive out before Israel, including the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
The angel of the Lord shall go before Israel and drive out the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
God promises to send an angel before Israel and drive out the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
Exhortation to keep the Lord's commands and not add anything to or take anything away from what He commands.
Israel shall keep all that the Lord commands, without adding to it or taking from it.
God reveals to Moses that He will lead the people out of Egypt and into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
Joshua assures Israel that the living God will drive out the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites, and Jebusites.
Joshua reminds the people that the Lord drove out the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites, Girgashites, Hivites, and Jebusites before them.
Exhortation to diligently keep the Lord's commands and testimonies which He has commanded.
Paul refers to God destroying seven nations in the land of Canaan and giving Israel the land as an inheritance.
Complementary account: 23:28 describes the means (hornets) while 34:11 confirms the final action (God drives them out).
Prophetic precursor to instruction: 34:11 promises destruction, while Deut 20:17 gives the theological basis (the ban) for the action.
